name: ATMOSPHERE OS — PAYMENT BADGE ALIGNMENT
changes: Promotes the audited RC1.32 storefront, checkout, account, PWA and backend delivery package to the stable v16 line
Keeps catalogue purchase actions aligned by showing “Ще немає відгуків” in the existing review row when approved reviews are absent
Preserves the original RC1.32 catalogue geometry without fixed card-body heights or description clipping
Retains the refined post-purchase experience and direct Discovery Set route from an empty cart
Removes the unsupported frame-ancestors directive from meta CSP policies to eliminate misleading console warnings
Synchronizes public assets, generated product content, PWA caches, admin PWA and verification tooling to 16.0.1
Raises the plata by mono badge by 3 px in the online-card option for cleaner optical alignment with the payment title
notes: Card payment code is included and boundary-tested; one real owner-card transaction remains the required live production acceptance test.
frame-ancestors can only be enforced through an HTTP response header, not a meta tag.
